decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan no. 81PG-EX-001, and drawing nos. 81PG-EX-003, 81PG-EX-004, 81PG-P3-004, 81PG-P3-006, and 81PG-P3-007 received: 16 November 2016. Drawing no. 81PG-P-002 Rev A received: 14 December 2016. Drawing nos. 81PG-P3-005 Rev A, 81PG-P-008 Rev B, and 81PG-P-009 Rev C received: 15 December 2016. Drawing no. 81PG-P3-003 Rev A received: 16 December 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a side and rear roof extension with two roof windows  to front elevation and erection of a single storey rear extension
